output.name: Halvun

anatomy.part: left wing corner, where the edge turns toward the mouth
belly, left of the mouth line
body centre, the heart of the ray
tail base, on the trailing edge of the wings

output.myth: When the Gale Tavo took Hanur's son out past the Leeward rocks, the ray Halvun was the first to see the boat go. She is no fish. She has wings of salt-grey hide, and she flies the dark carrying what the sea gives back: rope ends, oar-pins, a split thole. Ennu cut the cloth for her wings and Kael taught her to hold a thing without crushing it. Each boat that does not come home leaves its gear on the water. Halvun gathers it and carries it up along the Unflown, where nothing is lost but everything is kept. My grandmother said the ray was looking for the boat. Hesk keeps the count of what comes back. The ray keeps the count of what does not. If you find an oar-pin in the shallows at dawn, do not tie it to anything. Leave it for her. Do not ask where she takes it.
output.verse:
Halvun carries pins,
rope-ends from the drowned boats' dark,
no hand takes them home.
